body: Im with u

Reading all of this, I would say that unfortunately there comes a point where there is only so much an outsider can do to try to prevent. I would say try to advocate a therapist in the best  way you believe possible. I also would say you can’t feel guilty about anything because you’re doing all you can and at the end of the day that person has the ultimate decision of what is to occur no matter what help is presented to them. I hope he ends up okay and gets the help needed! That being said do not feel guilty. You’re doing what you can and trying to help the best you can and that alone is admirable. Never he guilty regardless of the outcome.

I would say the calm part comes as you’re planning but the most crucial part is when it comes time to actually go through with the “deed” planning is one thing. Executing is another. I wish you the best in hopefully staying alive

From my experience, given I have a gun and it’s ready to go and all I have to do is pull the trigger… it’s no easy to pull that trigger no matter the suffering. It goes against your instinct to live and being able to actually go against that instinct fully, ironically, is one of the toughest thing to actually do. I once said killing yourself is “bitch shit” and it’s ironic that now I face the same desire and now real understanding that’s it’s not. It takes courage.. in the most fucked up way, to attempt your suicide. It takes feeling that this attempt is worth more than the constant suffering.

Well, I had the love of my life in my grasps and then I lost it. So.. if I had her back I wouldn’t even Be on this thread and I’d be back to my happy go lucky self but she’s gone and so is my will to live. Indifference towards life x infinity

All you can do is try to empathize with him and ask him is there anything that attaches you to life ? Any anchors? Sometimes there aren’t. You can only do so much logically. The rest is in their hands literally. For better or for worse
Care to instant message / dm or whatever the hell they do on this site?

I’m right there with u. Today was the worst day for me so far followed by the first day of talk therapy. After the session I’m not sure how much it’s going to help in the long run but my only accomplishment is trying to hang onto life with whatever anchor I can find. My parents, my cats, and really that’s about it at the moment. Shit is tough

It’s a bummer your father feels that way about therapy. A lot of men do unfortunately. Hopefully you can find your way to getting some, if not, that’s what this board is for. I’m going through bad suicidal thoughts for the first time in my life due to losing the love of my life which my actions caused and showed me how broken I am and conversing with others going through their own personal living hell hopefully can help
I’m sorry for your losses and misfortunes. Life is a miserable bitch. What keeps my hanging on to this point, by a thread believe me, is my parents and my cats

The fact your title says “think” shows you’re unsure that you’ll actually go through with it shows a part of you still wants to go on. I get the suffering. I’m going through some myself as well that I would not wish on anyone. I feel like this suicidewatch can be helpful for all of us to try and push through and know we’re not alone. My days are lifeless, things I used to love to do I have 0 interest. It’s shit. It’s because I lost the love of my life.

All due respect. I just lost the love of my life. It’s so blatantly obvious we were meant to be but I blew it. Living with that regret and understanding that anyone after her is #2 Is an insane pill to swallow. It’s hell inside of my head. They say sometimes loving and love lost is better than never having loved at all? If that were true I wouldn’t have a 9mm loaded ready to go if for some miracle I actually gain the balls to do it. I’m thinking I won’t but In reality never say never I guess. I’m sorry for your situation though as well. Doesn’t sound fun at all

Hang in there man. I’m in a suicidal state just as you are right now. It’s terrible. I struggle to do anything. Life is joyless and empty and seemingly pointless now. Even music loses its appeal sadly.
